content: Ticker/cashtag normalization best practice: canonicalize all ticker-like tokens to a single bare lowercase form (e.g. amzn) at extraction time, and match on the canonical form rather than the decorated one. Cashtag $AMZN, bare ticker AMZN, and company-name aliases (Amazon) should all resolve to the same canonical entity id. This is the standard approach in financial NER (FinNer, ticker-mapping tables). TrendCast already has the alias infrastructure: KNOWN_TICKERS set + KNOWN_ORGS alias map in entities.ts, and extractEntities already normalizes $AMZN to bare 'amzn' (normalized field) while keywords.ts keeps the '$' prefix in keywords. The gap is keywords.ts, not entities.ts.
